description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart labeled “Task Type” that represents the distribution of task types in the referenced paper, and it contains two slices. The larger slice is labeled “Article generation (83.2%)” and is shown in a muted red/pink color, occupying a bit over four-fifths of the ring. The smaller slice is labeled “generation (16.8%)” and is shown in a pale yellow color, taking up the remaining portion. The chart places the title text “Task Type” in the center of the donut, shows percentage values directly in the slice labels outside the ring, and does not include a separate legend; no slices appear exploded or offset, and the two segments are not presented with an explicit ordering beyond their placement around the ring.
